title: web client: Contact/get call fails — method is ChatContact/get
description: app.js fetchContacts() (line 231) calls the JMAP method 'Contact/get'. The dispatcher registers 'ChatContact/get' (kithd/src/lib.rs line 327). Result: every fetchContacts() call returns unknownMethod and the contact list is empty for all web client users. Similarly, handleStateEvent (line 865) watches for state key 'Contact' but server emits 'ChatContact' — contact sync on push never fires. Fix: rename all Contact/* method calls in app.js to ChatContact/*.
